applicableDomain: Patient Portal Enrollment, Scoped Proxy Access, Consent & Privacy-Minimized Result/Queue Views
descriptionAndPurpose: Enrolls verified MPI patients with preferred ISO 639-1 language (EN/FR), governs time-bound scoped proxy access (spouse/caregiver), enforces consent/opt-out for notifications, and exposes privacy-minimized waiting-room queue status and released summaries.
prerequisiteConditions: Verified MPI identity and authenticated real contact address (zero placeholders).
safetyChecks: Proxy grants strictly scoped by PortalScope and expiry timestamp.
Patient-facing queue status never exposes clinical diagnoses or sensitive PHI.
Result release respects clinician review and local release policy.
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Proxy grants and portal accounts can be revoked immediately with zero deletion of historical clinical audit records.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: @ClinicalAudit records portal enrollment, proxy scope grant/revocation, and patient result views.
completionCriteria: Patient engaged with verified access, active consent preferences, and closed care-team threads.
